hooks.command: grep -qiE 'paste|copy|custom code|ghl' && echo 'Rule from Marcus (corrected twice): when giving GHL paste steps, give the full code of every block ready to copy, page by page, never just file paths or attachments. Chat messages cannot carry HTML with script or img tags, so publish a paste-kit artifact with one Copy button per block and say which element on which page each goes in.' || true

grep -qiE 'ghl|highlevel|calendar|workflow|setting|menu|where' && echo 'Rule from Marcus (corrected twice): never state a GHL menu path, tab, field or button as fact from memory. Only describe UI you have seen in a screenshot Marcus sent or a GHL help page you actually opened this session. If you cannot verify, say so plainly and ask for a screenshot of the screen instead of guessing.' || true

grep -qiE 'ghl|workflow|fired|email|sms|review|custom value|why' && echo 'Rule from Marcus (corrected twice): never name a workflow, setting or custom value as the cause of a GHL event until you have checked it against live GHL data this session (custom values, contacts, message export, workflow list, or a log/screenshot Marcus sent). Label anything unchecked as a guess, and say what would confirm it.' || true

grep -qiE 'rank|treg|serp|prospect|keyword|maps|position' && echo 'Rule from Marcus (corrected twice): never report a Google ranking position from a keyword database (Serpstat, SpyFu, DataForSEO Labs) as fact. Verify every position you report with a live Google search set to a Sydney location (crawl4ai.google.serp.organic, country=au), and say the search location. Map Pack and organic positions are separate lists; label which one each number is. Only report buying-intent terms (no cost, price, how-to, ideas or DIY searches).' || true

echo 'Before replying: list every change the user asked for in this message and earlier ones, add each as a check in the deliverable folder checks/requests.py, apply them all, then attach or sync every changed file (post_message takes 6 attachments max, so send the rest too).'
